newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE futures volume up 18 pct in 96/97 year to date.
newsitem.headline: WCE futures volume up 18 pct in 96/97 year to date.

text.p: Volume of trade in Winnipeg Commodity Exchange futures contracts was up 18.1 percent in the 1996/97 (Aug/July) crop year to date but volume in May was down 22 percent relative to May 1996, a WCE statement said.
Canola futures volume was up 17.4 percent in the year to date with 1,210,666 contracts changing hands compared to 1,031,646 in the same preriod of the prior year.
May volume of trade in canola futures, however, was down 20.9 percent compared to the previous May while open interest as of May 30 was down 13.9 percent at 47,857 contracts outstanding.

Feed wheat futures monthly volume remained virtually unchanged compared to the prior month of May. But crop year to date volume in feed wheat was up 23.8 percent while open interest was up 33.4 percent on May 30 at 10,125 contracts.
Western barley futures crop year to date volume was up 44.5 percent as 288,460 contracts changed hands compared to 199,604 in the same period the year before.

May volume in barley, however, was down 32.9 percent as 17,228 contracts traded compared to 25,659 last May and open interest on May 30 was down 27.2 percent at 14,044 contracts compared to 19,288 on May 30, 1996.
Flax futures volume from August to May fell 21.1 percent while monthly volume in May was down 42.4 percent and opent interest rose 16 percent to 5,092 contracts outstanding as of May 30.
